title: The canonical inverse-projection counit as a natural transformation
statement: For a proper map q:X→Y of Noetherian schemes and finite commutative coefficient ring A, a complex L and trace τ:Rq_*L→A_Y define the natural transformation Rq_*(q^*(-) tensor L)→id. Its component is the inverse of the specified ordered proper projection of [lem-amb-proper-coproducts-projection], followed by tensoring with τ and the specified unit constraint. In particular this construction applies to the projective line and the trace given by the inverse of any splitting of [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-data].

proof.text: Map τ followed by the constant-unit isomorphism under the right-tensor functor, and compose with the natural right unitor. Compose this tensor trace with the inverse projection. Cancelling a natural transformation with its inverse gives the displayed ordered projection equation. Proper projective space and [pqf-lem-locnoeth-lft] give the Noetherian source needed for its projective-line specialization.
